summary: Go stdlib-only program animates the live innertube API like yt-dlp: search returning first-10 music videos works via WEB (params EgIQAQ); next with RD<videoId> works on both youtube (WEB, 25 items) and YouTube Music (WEB_REMIX, 50 items, artist clean from shortBylineText); ios_producer is the only tested client identity with audio formats carrying plain signed URLs (no PO token, no JS): itag 139 (HE-AAC 51 kb/s) and 140 (AAC-LC 132 kb/s), range GET 206 with 262143B. Single plain GET (no Range header) is throttled to ~32 KB/s; Range header or parallel ranged GETs reach 9-31 MB/s, so streaming runs ~2x realtime even throttled and much faster when ranged. android_vr, tv, tv_samsung, visionos return LOGIN_REQUIRED without cookies; ios and android return OK formats but WITHOUT any url or signatureCipher field (SABR-era), so they would require further work.

clients.notes: OK but formats carry no url/signatureCipher (only one of the two itags 599/600 mentioned before); unusable without extra work.

open_issues: ios_producer's audio bitrates may be limited (only itags 139/140, no Opus 251) and its purpose is a producer app; stability over time is unproven.
Full download (no Range header) is throttled to ~32221 bytes/s by the server: assistants must send a Range header (or use ranged GETs) when streaming.
Small percentage of videos may still need testing for age/geo restrictions with ios_producer.
Result is per one server region (US-ish); yt-dlp recommends multiple clients with fallback.
